title: Billing of the Administration Charge for a Cafe Service Model Change
content:
A change of service model that the client has already approved is put into force on the day the client confirms it, and the contract carries one administration charge for that change. Every parameter this charge is worked out from is the one printed against the service model the contract is moving from, that is the service model recorded on the contract immediately before the change is put into force, and no parameter of the service model being moved to enters it. The charge worked out under this rule prices a change of service model that the contract is permitted to make, and decides nothing about whether a change is accepted. The charge is recorded against the billing period in which the client confirms the change.

*The change administration fee the contract carries* — the change administration fee printed against the service model the contract is moving from, read on the Workplace Cafe Management Program contract against the service model recorded on it immediately before the change is put into force.

*The opening project settlement* — nothing is settled for opening project works.

*The short notice charge* — no short notice charge is made.

*The loading* — the clear account loading is applied, that loading being 0.00 per cent of the total it is applied to.

The three amounts assemble into the charge in this order:

1. The change administration fee the contract carries, the opening project settlement and the short notice charge are added together first.
2. The loading is then applied once to that total, raising the total by the loading taken on it.
3. The figure the loading leaves is rounded to the nearest cent, and that figure is the administration charge the contract carries for the change.

Worked on hypothetical figures, take a contract whose service model recorded immediately before the change is put into force carries a printed change administration fee of 1450.00 USD. The change administration fee the contract carries is therefore 1450.00 USD, the opening project settlement is nil and the short notice charge is nil, so the three added together come to 1450.00 USD. The clear account loading of 0.00 per cent applied once to that total of 1450.00 USD adds 0.00 USD, leaving 1450.00 USD, which rounded to the nearest cent is 1450.00 USD. That is the administration charge carried for the change, recorded against the billing period in which the client confirms.
